integrity: The 139-type reduction, explicit size-11 witness, and nonexistence of a size-10 dominating family are reproduced by a standalone standard-library verifier. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound is an exhaustive finite computation on the reduced cyclic-subgroup comparability graph, not a general closed formula.
No claim is made for arbitrary three-prime nilpotent groups or other domination variants.
title: The proper power graph of \(C_2^2\times C_3^2\times C_5^2\) has domination number \(11\)
